fix.shows: The Indian Express reports that Sarthak Sidhant, a student from Jharkhand, says his team read about 6.8 lakh of the Commission's Uttar Pradesh roll PDFs, most of them scans, by optical character recognition, covering the 2024 Lok Sabha roll, both rolls of the intensive revision and the 2027 draft. The paper reports that the data hold 15.36 crore entries set out as 54.8 crore rows, in one table for each of the 403 constituencies, released free on 24 November. His post on X links to the s1d labs release. The paper notes that the Commission had put the rolls online in April mainly as scanned PDFs, and that the Commission had not responded to the claim.
